choice: MIT license. Issues on, forms only (no blank issues), with the interaction limit existing_users, renewed every six months. Discussions, wiki and projects off. Squash merges only, web commit sign-off required, DCO. Rulesets keep main and v* tags from being deleted or rewritten. Secret scanning with push protection and private vulnerability reporting on. Actions: GitHub-owned only, pinned to SHAs, read-only token, approval for external contributors' runs. CI runs the unit tests on Python 3.9 and 3.13.
context: First public release on GitHub; spam control modelled on the maintainer's other public repository.
rejected: Issues off with collaborators_only (no channel for user feedback); contributors_only (blocks first-time reporters); GPL-3.0 (needed only while the GPL cmux SDK was linked); pre-commit, a gitleaks history scan and OpenSSF Scorecard (out of proportion for a project this size).
title: Public repository: MIT license, issues open to accounts older than a day
